name: BinaryPH AI SEO – Focus Keywords
author: BinaryPH

sections.description:
Boost SEO with AI-generated focus keywords for posts, pages & products. Works with Yoast, Rank Math & WooCommerce. Full instructions: https://binary.ph/binaryph-ai-seo/

External Services

This plugin connects to third-party APIs to fetch AI-generated focus keyword suggestions based on post, page or product titles. Requests may be sent to one of the following services depending on user configuration:

Google Gemini – Used for keyword generation. Sends prompt data.
Models: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models
Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
Terms: https://policies.google.com/terms

OpenRouter – Sends content data to selected models.
Models: https://openrouter.ai/models?q=free&order=newest
Privacy: https://openrouter.ai/privacy
Terms: https://openrouter.ai/terms

xAI Grok – Processes input to generate keywords.
Models: https://docs.x.ai/docs/models
Privacy: https://x.ai/legal/privacy-policy
Terms: https://x.ai/legal/terms-of-service

OpenWebUI – Connects with self-hosted or compatible models.
Models: https://openwebui.com/models
